$comment: Hand-authored input of scripts/gen_test_classification.py. One entry per row of the 'Behaviours that are easy to lose' table in docs/RUST_REWRITE_EVIDENCE.md, matched by exact Area and Behaviour text. 'tests' names tracked test files (a path ending in '/' names a directory of them) and, where identifiable, the test functions ('name' or 'Class::name'; JS: the test title) that pin the row. A row without a pinning test keeps 'tests': [] and an explicit 'gap'; a partial pin also carries a 'gap'. The generator validates every path and function.

cases.behaviour: Admission, concurrency and fan-out are always unlimited; only retention may follow the launch probe
No refusal on RSS, memory headroom or cgroup pressure; no `server_busy`; no worker recycling; executors start every accepted job
Coordinator delegation ignores a persisted `maxConcurrent`
Tofu-started work writes `oom_score_adj=1000`; server processes keep the inherited value
Durable state is reclaimed only by reachability, never by budget; 1,000 idle conversations add no resident state
A failing `__str__` cannot replace the original failure or its recovery class
Tool calls take no workspace lease; per-path mutex for one read-modify-write, sorted, reentrant; calls in a round run in parallel
Fair shared/exclusive admission lapses on its own; a holder never yields to itself
Atomic writers own the temp descriptor and close it in every path; ENOENT during a racing replace on FUSE is not absence
Heartbeat persistence cannot block the serving loop
Storage socket replies, half-closes, then waits for client EOF
A finalizer (`Drop`) never blocks; an interrupted close restores the open state
Timeout, cancellation, exit status and error kind are reported independently
cases.gap: Only the second half of DEFENSIVE_PATTERNS.md 'Report orthogonal outcomes independently' (a command's result survives its group's retirement) has a located test. No test was found that asserts timed_out, cancellation, exit status and error kind of one tool round are reported as independent facts (round_entry status in lib/tasks_pkg/tool_dispatch/_pipeline.py).

cases.behaviour: Post-commit notices publish after the lock, in commit order, from one publisher
Signal handling is a self-pipe; 500 SIGTERMs stop the host exactly once
Helpers spawn from the code loaded at boot, never the live checkout (in Rust: a spawned helper matches the running binary's digest)
Untrusted output gets random exclusive paths in a 0700 directory; children get a scrubbed environment
cases.gap: Only the scrubbed/explicit child environment half has located tests. No test was found that pins files derived from model, tool or remote output to a random exclusive-create name inside a 0700 directory (DEFENSIVE_PATTERNS.md 'Untrusted output gets no predictable path and no inherited secrets').

cases.behaviour: Chaos fault contracts keep their documented outcomes
Terminal state is monotonic; settlement and terminal projection commit together; a terminal queue drain dispatches at most one successor
cases.gap: TURN_SETTLEMENT.md 'Invariants to test' names the primary suite only; no test function in it was identified by name for terminal monotonicity or for 'a terminal queue drain dispatches at most one successor'.

cases.behaviour: One `ABORT_CAUSES` table; an unknown reason reads as a person's Stop and logs ERROR once
A failed terminal commit replays the retained terminal event; nothing reaches the browser before commit
Interruption recovery rewinds to the last protocol-valid boundary and resends byte-identically: no prefill, no synthetic "continue"
A Stop ack means accepted, not settled; late frames raise typed cancellation, never `server_busy`
`git_guard` refusals stay failed with no automatic retry
Background-command receipt and queue-row removal commit in one transaction; ACK only after verified completion
A steer receipt stays within 64 KiB even for a 1.2 MB Turn
A content-filter or refusal skips same-model retries, bills `R<n>-REFUSED`, discards partial text and retries once on the fallback
A refusal applies to one request; the next returns to the primary except the single request repeating the refused payload; every switch emits `MODEL_FALLBACK`
Empty or truncated stop is not a content filter; 402 and 429 never stamp one
A resumed Attempt runs on the accepted model, not the last fallback
Non-read-only calls commit an intent with an exact storage ack before entry; reads pay nothing
`entered` is not success; post-entry exceptions are `unknown`; only typed pre-entry refusals become `not_started`
A lost-executor `write_file` gets a non-retryable `tool_effect_unknown` receipt; a new write to that target needs an earlier-round inspection and, if still unknown, a human gate
After restart, only `unknown`-class cut calls block resume; a call stopped before it ran is repeatable
One commit point (stopping the old worker); past it the manager always ends serving
A failed or slow engine build never blocks an application restart
A refused restart names every bridge and reason; outcomes go only to `logs/server-manager.log`
Preparation phases and timing fields; the browser warns at 180 s but keeps observing

functions: unknown and older phases cannot replace the last confirmed phase
automatic retry relays on the same bounded observer and keeps elapsed progress

cases.gap: No located test pins the 180 s warn-once threshold itself (docs/modules/infra_runtime.md 'Restart observation'); the restart-observation unit test pins phase ordering, retry and non-overlapping observation.

cases.behaviour: Quiesced Turns resume exactly once from their checkpoint, including Routers and swarm masters
Landings and exports hold a protected-steps marker; restart never boots a half-landed tree
Forwarded human input is byte-identical text from a genuine human Turn; a router note is never authority
Live restart needs a human decision or the owner's revocable Global Router grant, bound to one router and revision; every use audited
Continuations keep the full role catalog; owner-only decisions are gated at execution
Synthetic users never inherit human authorization
The Hope queue ban is re-read on every submit, rerun, clone and retry; a missing policy enforces the default

The Hope token is read in place, never copied or logged, and verified on an endpoint that checks it; the MLP refresh token rotates and must never be copied (a copy revokes the host session); the patrol never renews or prompts
No wall-clock deadline on summaries; only verified complete outputs qualify; failure keeps the sources; an overfull prompt is refused, never head-truncated
One provider-independent compactor; L1 and L2 planned jointly on a detached candidate, adopted durably
Credential outages and rotation retry within the documented bound and settle failed attempts authentically
The full active checklist survives final admission and compaction
Only proven connection-setup failures change route; status codes, read timeouts and ambiguous disconnects never replay
Provider pacing is FIFO per quota lane and learns limits only from provider signals
Replay-safe calls wait out transient errors with no total window while the authority is alive; `request_not_dispatched` must be literal `true`
A queued Turn pair runs before any later Turn-less source
Canonical JSON bytes (sorted keys, orjson number and string formatting) match where digests, receipts or storage.v1 depend on them
Admission waits heartbeat liveness; `AbortedError` lands as CANCELLED with no retry
SSE resume, heartbeat and frame vocabulary; push WebSocket limits and error codes
